SQL:
WITH _base AS (
  SELECT
    customers.tier AS "customers.tier",
    COUNT(*) AS "customers.n",
    COUNT(DISTINCT customers.id) AS "customers.nd"
  FROM customers AS customers
  GROUP BY
    customers.tier
), _cm_customers__orders__amount_sum AS (
  SELECT
    customers.tier AS "orders.customers.tier",
    CAST(SUM(orders.amount) AS DOUBLE) AS "orders.amount_sum"
  FROM orders AS orders
  LEFT JOIN customers AS customers
    ON orders.customer_id = customers.id
  GROUP BY
    customers.tier
)
SELECT
  _base."customers.tier",
  _base."customers.n",
  _base."customers.nd",
  _cm_customers__orders__amount_sum."orders.amount_sum" AS "customers.rev"
FROM _base
LEFT JOIN _cm_customers__orders__amount_sum
  ON _base."customers.tier" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM _cm_customers__orders__amount_sum."orders.customers.tier"
LIMIT 21
